title: ScheduledTaskCreate
description: Authoring shape for createSchedule. The client supplies only what it owns — name, cron, persona_id, action. Server-owned fields (id, status, created_at, updated_at, last_run_at, next_run_at) are forbidden — the server assigns them (status defaults to enabled; run timestamps start null). Sub-schemas are $ref'd from scheduled-task.json so they cannot drift. Normative.
